description: Sample up to 7 pages of a site, starting from the given URL and following its links, and report what a crawler extracts from each one: a verdict, word count, crawlable links versus JavaScript-only links, and whether the page is an empty app shell. Also reports which AI crawlers the site blocks in robots.txt. This samples pages, it does not crawl the whole site. Fetches from this machine, so it needs no token and has no rate limit.

url.description: The public URL to start from, usually the home page.

name: analyze_site
title: Analyze site
